title: PS5 Horizontal Stand
author: ale_elli
description:
If you are sick of the standard PS5 stand, this is the model for you! with this stand, your PS5 Standard is more stable and has a better airflow under it. This stand has vertical walls to prevent it from slipping towards the center of the console.

**STAND FOR DIGITAL VERSION:** https://makerworld.com/en/models/205101#profileId-225310

playstation ps5 playstation5
